title: GOD'S ABUNDANT GRACE
2 CORINTHIANS 9:8
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision

scenes.a: When fear whispers that your work is not enough, bring your heavy heart to God.
And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
Lord, we surrender our fragile plans and practical needs into Your faithful hands today.
Where resources feel slender and decisions press hard upon us, grant us Your wisdom and calm assurance.
Supply our daily bread, protect our labor, and give us generous hearts to serve others well.
You are our constant provider, and in Your abundant grace we rest completely.
